title: Builder Signals · 2026-10-27
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 14 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 7 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie offered a sober read on enterprise security: an endless sprawl of libraries, tools, infrastructure, data and code has left the risk surface highly fragmented, and most large enterprises can barely keep up—let alone startups or companies outside tech. Fragmented data means firms don't really know their risk posture at any moment; some systems grant privileges too broadly, others rely on security through obscurity. His point: modernize data and infra first, and then agents can help secure the env…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 对大型企业的安全现状做了一个相当清醒的判断：库、工具、基础设施、数据和代码持续膨胀，风险面高度碎片化，大多数大企业都跟不上，更别说初创公司和非科技企业。数据分散意味着企业根本不知道自己任一时刻的风险状态——有的系统权限开得过宽，有的则靠"隐蔽即安全"在撑。他的核心观点是：先把数据和基础设施现代化，才有机会让 Agent 来帮忙守护环境——Agent 集群可以并行调用各类安全工具、模拟攻击变种、读日志、评估企业数据风险，而这种能力是最近几个月随着长时运行 Agent 和足够好的 computer use 才出现的。他认为身份、防火墙、网络、代码扫描、数据保护等安全栈每一层都有巨大机会，也让人对攻防平衡保持乐观，但前提是每家企业都得先把基础打牢。

featured.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
featured.summaryEn: Peter Yang shared a workflow for using Claude to copy any short-video style in minutes, quoting Jake Moran of HyperFrames: it's now a native capability in HyperFrames studio—upload or pick a reference clip, describe in the prompt what to change, see where the inspiration is drawn from, and apply different fonts or colors while keeping the same structural idea. He also shared a piece of work with the comment "Who said AI doesn't have taste."
featured.insightZh: Peter Yang 分享了一个用 Claude 在几分钟内复刻任意短视频风格的做法，引用 HyperFrames 的 Jake Moran：他们已把这做成 HyperFrames studio 的原生能力——上传或选一段参考视频，再在 prompt 里描述想改什么，就能看到借鉴了哪些元素，并替换字体、配色等，结构上仍保持同一思路。他另外转了一个作品并感叹"谁说 AI 没有品味"。

featured.title: The Changing Physics of Cybersecurity and Drug Development with OpenAI President Greg Brockman
featured.summaryEn: Greg Brockman argues AI can now definitively generate new knowledge, the physics of cybersecurity are changing—we are in a "defender's window" and security spend should vastly outstrip software spend—and drug discovery is the next domain to be revolutionized. OpenAI co-founder and President Greg Brockman joined No Priors. He framed this week's math results as a milestone: whether AI can produce new knowledge is now "impossible to deny." OpenAI published nearly 400 resolved open problems, and mathematicians are mining them for genuinely surprising insights—unlike brute-force proofs such as the four color theorem. He tied human-comprehensible AI output to alignment techniques like debate and iterative amplification, which keep humans in the driver's seat. Math broke through largely because of data; biology is data-bottlenecked, but from first principles there's no reason a neural net shou…
featured.insightZh: Greg Brockman 认为 AI 已明确能产生新知识，网络安全的"物理规律"正在改变——现在是防守方窗口期，未来安全投入应远超软件投入；下一个被重塑的大领域是药物研发。 OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁 Greg Brockman 做客 No Priors。他把本周的数学成果视为里程碑：AI 能否产生新知识的问题"已无法否认"，OpenAI 公布了近 400 个被解决的重要开放问题，数学界正在从中挖掘洞见，专家反馈其中有出人意料的思路，而非四色定理式的"机器穷举"。他还谈到 debate、iterative amplification 等让人类能监督超出自身检验能力的 AI 的方法，并与"人类在驾驶座"的对齐理念挂钩。关于数学为何率先突破，他认为核心在数据；生物领域受数据瓶颈制约，但从第一性原理看，神经网络没有理由擅长自然语言却不擅长"生物的语言"。药物研发是他心中最该被彻底改造的领域，除了分子本身，监管申报材料、N-of-1 疾病、文献中已存在却未被发现的疗法都是可加速的环节；监管最终应随"药物研发物理规律"被证明改变而调整。 产品层面，他介绍 DOTS——一个基于 Astra 级模型、拥有独立云电脑、始终在线的主动式 Agent，会追踪他该回的消息、日历冲突、Slack 和邮箱里的待办，"形态变化而非能力变化"，却是职场的 game changer。他认为消费与企业助手会融合，主要差别是算力成本与管理员控制；最好的 UI 是没有 UI，GPT-6 已支持先快速作答再继续思考，以及即时生成式 UI。 网络安全是本期重点。他提出"防守方窗口期"：前沿能力尚未广泛扩散，防守方应抓紧利用——OpenAI 通过 Daybreak 计划向防守方开放模型，并承诺 10 亿美元支持一线防守者，与 CrowdStrike 等合作。内部做法是抽调约 25 名生产工程师暂停项目，用当时最强模型扫遍基础设施直至"饱和"，每次新模型发布都重复一次。他认为互联网长期为韧性而非安全而建，积累的安全技术债将集中暴露，而 AI 让形式化验证、偿还技术债、审计供应链变得可行；软件越来越便宜，可靠…

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Commenting on an interview, Zara Zhang argued that most people overestimate the importance of one huge launch and underestimate the power of simply showing up on the timeline every day. Building a system to make a video daily beats spending tens of thousands of dollars on a single launch video.
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 评论一段访谈时指出：大多数人高估了一次大型发布的重要性，却低估了每天在时间线上持续出现的力量。与其花几万美元做一支发布视频，不如建立一套每天产出一条视频的系统。

items.title: Nan Yu · OpenAI Codex 产品，前 Linear 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: Nan Yu, product at OpenAI Codex, shared two product-quality observations: he called out how bad the default looks for unoptimized apps even though the iPhone Duo supports split mode, and warned that by the time a UX problem shows up in data or UXR interviews it's too late—the damage is done and the reputation tarnished.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 产品的 Nan Yu 发了两条产品体验观察：一是吐槽 iPhone Duo 已支持分屏模式，但未适配的 App 默认表现依然糟糕；二是强调体验问题等到在数据或用户研究访谈里显现时，往往已经太晚——伤害已经造成，口碑已经受损。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux of OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT reminded users that ChatGPT on web lets you customize its appearance to make it more soothing. A separate cryptic post—"Day 21/ Wonder what happens the remaining seven days. But today is a reset."—drew strong engagement.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 的 Thibault Sottiaux 提醒用户，网页版 ChatGPT 可以自定义外观，调成更舒缓的样式。另一条则是隐晦的"第 21 天，好奇剩下七天会发生什么，但今天是一次重置"，获得了较高关注。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital 合伙人、MAD Podcast 主持人
items.summaryEn: FirstMark's Matt Turck poked fun at the VC world: "Rare footage of how VCs turned their 2021 bets in metaverse, gaming and crypto mining into 'mission-critical AI infrastructure'"—a jab at the rebranding happening under the AI infra narrative.
items.insightZh: FirstMark 的 Matt Turck 调侃 VC 圈："罕见影像：看 VC 们如何把 2021 年押注的元宇宙、游戏和加密挖矿，包装成'关键任务型 AI 基础设施'"——点出当下 AI 基建叙事中的重新包装现象。
